scripts.verify:dist: node -e "(function(){const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const d='dist';if(!fs.existsSync(d)){console.error('dist not found; run npm run build first');process.exit(2);}const hits=[];function walk(dir){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(dir)){const fp=p.join(dir,f);const st=fs.statSync(fp);if(st.isDirectory())walk(fp);else if(/\.(js|html|css)$/.test(f)){const c=fs.readFileSync(fp,'utf8');if(/\bvoid\s+tsx\b|\btsx\s*;/.test(c))hits.push(fp);}}}walk(d);if(hits.length){console.error('ERROR: bundle contains stray tsx reference in:\n'+hits.join('\n'));process.exit(1);}else{console.log('OK: no stray tsx reference in dist');}})();"
